basic_details.job_title: NMPA Senior Deputy Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 42 years. (Note: The post is to be filled on Deputation basis).

qualification.details: Officers holding analogous posts or post of Dy. Secretary or equivalent posts in the respective discipline of GAD in the scale of pay of Rs. 13000-18250 in Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs or Autonomous Bodies with 3 years regular service in the grade will be eligible. For absorption through composite method, Officers holding analogous posts or the post of Dy. Secretary or equivalent posts in the respective discipline of GAD (such as CPRO/Dy. Estate Manager/Dy. Chief Law Officer/Personnel Officer) in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust or Deputy Secretary or equivalent posts in the respective discipline of GAD with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.10750-16750 & Rs.13000-18250 in the respective discipline of GAD in a Major Port Trust will be eligible. | For deputation, Officers holding analogous posts or post of Dy. Secretary or equivalent posts in the respective discipline of GAD in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 in Govt./ Semi Govt./PSUs or Autonomous Bodies with 3 years regular service in the grade will be eligible. The selection is by merit for which the bench mark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below "very good".

salary_details.details: During the period of deputation the employee will have the option either to get his/her pay fixed in the deputation post under the operation of the normal rules or to draw pay of the post held by him/her in his parent department + a deputation allowance in accordance with and subject to the conditions as modified from time to time and such other general or special orders. Dearness allowance, local allowance, children's educational allowance, joining time pay and transfer T.A., travelling allowances, leave and pension, provident fund benefits, leave travel concession, and medical facilities are admissible as per rules.

selection_process: Selection is based on deputation rules and merit
for which the benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below "very good".
how_to_apply: Visit the "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
Fill out the online application form between 29.09.2026 and 28.10.2026.
Take a printout of the submitted online application.
Gather the required documents, APARs, educational certificates, administrative clearance, vigilance clearance, undertaking, and no objection certificate.
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary in New Mangalore Port Authority".

Forward the application through proper channel to the Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, General Administration Department, Administrative Building, Panambur Mangalore-575010 so as to reach on or before 12.11.2026.
Send an advance copy of the application to [email protected] on or before 28.10.2026.
important_instructions: Applications received only through proper channel within the due date along with requisite documents will be considered. Candidature of applicants whose advance copy is received by NMPA by the last date but whose proper channel application is not received within 15 days from the last date will not be considered. The officer selected will be governed by Service Rules and Regulations in force as amended from time to time. The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the last date of submission of online applications (28.10.2026). Any change in date for submission of application will be notified on the New Mangalore Port Authority website.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: (i) A degree from a recognised university. (ii) Twelve years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking. Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Mgt/ Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognised university.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for New Mangalore Port Authority
content_sections.text: Visit the "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. Fill out the online application form between 29.09.2026 and 28.10.2026. Take a printout of the submitted online application. Gather the required documents, APARs, educational certificates, administrative clearance, vigilance clearance, undertaking, and no objection certificate. Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary in New Mangalore Port Authority". Forward the application through proper channel to the Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, General Administration Department, Administrative Building, Panambur Mangalore-575010 so as to reach on or before 12.11.2026. Send an advance copy of the application to [email protected] on or before 28.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Copy of the online application. Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD. Statement showing year wise availability of APARs and grading for the last 5 years duly signed by the Head of Office/HOD (or No Report Certificate if not available). Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualifications, present and past work experience duly verified and certified. Administrative Clearance of the concerned Organization duly signed and stamped by the Head of the Department (Annexure-II). Vigilance clearance of the concerned Organization as per proforma prescribed by the Ministry (Annexure-III). Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected (Annexure-IV). No Objection Certificate of the respective organization to relieve the candidate. Details of any major or minor penalty imposed during the last 10 years along with disciplinary case documents. Veracity certificate towards educational qualification and degree recognition. Complete statement of service details with post held till date signed by Head of Office/HOD. Two recent passport size photographs.
